notes.title: QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers!

QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory is being updated today with many new features. These new updates should make you play our game even better.

We have added a New Level (The Knights Errant), UX/UI, text & cards improvements, new text for the armor, tutorial improvements (scenarios and combat), new card activation mechanics, character movement improvements (no wall trespassing) and sound effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123960/d6e369cda8f6c101cc537749488b7ca4d551532c.png

The new level is based on chapter 4 of the original book. Don Quixote meets the merchants of Toledo and he demands that the merchants must declare that Dulcinea is the most beautiful lady in the universe.

In “The Knights Errant”, punish the blasphemous knights who have not sworn to the beauty of Dulcinea. Stop them from leaving without getting their just desserts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123960/a37d3dda7a251ea7ee7b85146b91b53b067f7399.png

Share your feedback with us, and follow us on Twitter and Facebook.
Cheers!

Cubus Games.
